scripts.setup: cd packages/bridge && bun run dev:cli install
scripts.setup:dev: cd packages/bridge && bun run dev:cli install --dev
scripts.doctor: cd packages/bridge && bun run dev:cli doctor
scripts.bridges: cd packages/bridge && bun run dev:cli bridges
scripts.logs: cd packages/bridge && bun run dev:cli logs -f
scripts.unsetup: cd packages/bridge && bun run dev:cli uninstall
scripts.build: bun run --filter '*' build && bun run build:claude-plugin && bun run build:bridge
scripts.policy: cd packages/bridge && bun run dev:cli policy
